about_the_game:
The world is a big place when you're Tiny!

Tiny: The Last Wayfinder is a cozy exploration game set in a lush, oversized forest. You play as Twig, a tiny forest sprite on a journey to guide your village to safety along a migration path. Explore the forest, solve environmental puzzles, and unlock new areas using magical abilities and tools like a plant-growing spell and grappling hook.

Run along giant roots, jump over rocks, and duck under fallen branches. Climb up to the canopy of swaying leaves overhead to scout your path to the next location. Along the way you'll collect resources, rest at campsites to cook food, then return to your village to acquire tools, progress the story, and trade for cosmetic items.

There’s no combat — just exploration, movement, and discovery, with gentle creatures on a giant scale. Designed for players who enjoy calm, non-linear adventures focused on nature, traversal, and atmospheric beauty.

Key Features:

  • Freely explore a handcrafted forest from a tiny perspective

  • Unlock new areas with magical abilities and traversal tools

  • Interact with gentle wildlife and dynamic environmental details

  • Trade collectibles for cosmetic items

  • Relaxing music and ambient soundscapes

  • No combat – focus on exploration, discovery, and narrative

  • A focused, heartfelt adventure designed to be enjoyed in a few hours

  • Day / Night cycle and weather
